notes.title: Achievements Hotfix
notes.content: We're continuing to work on fixing achievements. Now, from the Main Menu, if you tap the Achievements submenu, you'll see a small red button in the lower right corner of the screen. Clicking on it will show you the achievements you've earned according to the game's internal database. If any of these achievements appear here as completed but not on Steam, use the menu at the top of this new window to try to fix it. This system is still rudimentary and is in the testing phase.

notes.title: Improving Dynamite
notes.content:
- Dynamite can now be equipped with hotkeys and auto-combines like ammo.

- Ushabti Warrior shields no longer suck dynamite into a space-time vortex as before.

- The explosion is now more beautiful and affects a larger area.

- Pressing the Aim button will allow you to throw dynamite farther.

notes.title: Chalenge Mode Hotfix
notes.content:
-You can now customize your gameplay experience in Challenge Mode by choosing difficulty, number of Sphinxes, and An-Ren phase.

-Rankings are now differentiated by difficulty.

-We've fixed the doors where the ushabti come out from, which were not displayed correctly.

notes.title: New Update: Challenge Mode!
notes.content:
Get ready to test your skills and endurance with the new Challenge Mode in Shadows of Duat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44216489/7dc04a6618c304f8cbd88e84b8bcc71964fd615c.png[/img]

-Fight through relentless waves of terrifying enemies in an intense, action-packed level.

-Choose from a wide arsenal of weapons, survive as long as possible, and achieve the highest score.

-Compete against players worldwide and climb your way up the global leaderboards.

This mode complements the core game experience, offering an extra adrenaline-packed challenge.

Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate mummy hunter?

notes.title: June update
notes.content: Minor aesthetic and performance adjustments.

notes.title: Changes to dodge mechanics and improved experience
notes.content:
- You can now roll with the Alt button at any time to dodge enemy attacks.
- Toggling between fixed and sustained running modes is now in the Options menu.
- We have increased the amount of ammunition in some areas.
- Luzbel will sometimes bring valuable objects to the Sanctuary.
- We have adjusted the impact radius of the cauldrons to make them easier to hit with shots.

notes.title: Mechanic adjustments and bug fixes
notes.content:
Adjustments to dodge and melee mechanics.

Added more ammunition and consumables in the scenarios.

Fixed bugs related to enemies that respawn after being defeated.

notes.title: November 24 Update
notes.content:
-Now Baron Don Rodrigo de Brumara has the voice of a professional actor (previously he had the voice of one of the developers), both in English and Spanish.

-Small visual improvements to some tomb decorations.

notes.title: November 6 Update
notes.content:
Fixed the new Journal system.

Fixed several achievements.

notes.title: November 5 Update
notes.content:
New feature! The Journal.

Now you will have a journal that is updated as you progress through the game. This will serve as a reminder of what you have found and gives you slight clues as to what you need to do next.

We've also fixed some bugs, such as enemies respawning in certain areas. And an achievement that didn't work properly.

notes.title: October 25
notes.content:
Fixed strange step on Map 5.
Fixed overlapping secret doors on Map 5.
Calibrated the amount of ammunition for cultists.
Adjusted Apophis Warriors trigger in the lake.
Graphical improvements to the "Summon Void" spell.
Lunar Passage Gate in Act 2.
Now, when enemies attack each other and are far away, they cannot be heard.
Fixed the Osiris light activator in the Hall of Judgment.
The spell "Amun's Protection" now grants you damage resistance.
Fixed lever collapsing when activated on Map 6.
Added the canopic glasses in the sequence before the end.
Map 7 events now update correctly.
When you defeat the An-Ren and Hope helps you as an NPC, he no longer stays shooting.
Adjustment to An-Ren's total health during final encounter.
Gunshot sound adjustment.
Fixed relationship between optenid canopic vessels and An-Ren transformations.
